_comment: Master list of display profiles. The Go server embeds this file; mkanim.py reads it; the firmware's config.h DISP_* block must match the entry for the panel it is compiled for. Formats: mono1 (1 bpp, MSB=left, bit 1=dark), gray4 (2 px/byte, high nibble=left, 0=black 15=white), rgb565 (2 B/px big-endian).
